purpose: Workspace for Experiment 3 viewer/simulator development. Active runs are copied from experiment2; experiment2_feed_nodes is preserved separately as source material.

excluded_initially.reason: Graph/topology issue; ngspice base run failed; reserved for graph correction or image-assisted phase.

viewer_rule: Every selectable run, including base run and scenarios, should get a 13_viewer_model.json generated from the netlist actually simulated by ngspice.
scenario_hook: After a scenario is executed by the web chat, generate the viewer model for that scenario run automatically.
source_collision_policy: Do not merge experiment2_feed_nodes scenarios into active scenarios automatically because scenario ids can collide.
